name: prompt-coach
description: A prompt coach for the terminal. At Enter it holds an eligible prompt for up to 5 s while a haiku first pass, and on a flag a standby sonnet or opus, judges whether nobody could act on it, it contradicts an earlier instruction, or it strays from a running task-runner card; only a confidently flagged prompt is dropped, and an animated pixel-art sprite shows your text, the reason and a rewrite, with buttons that fill the prompt box and never submit. Each eligible prompt bills a haiku call (a flagged one a standby call too, at most 10 a session), and /cost shows none of it. Terminal only; needs Claude Code 2.1.291; its own failures always pass the prompt. Off with CC_PROMPT_COACH=off.

cc_prompt_coach.title: Prompt coach (CC_PROMPT_COACH)
cc_prompt_coach.description: Judge an eligible prompt at Enter, and hold a flagged one for the sprite's rewrite: on or off. The environment variable CC_PROMPT_COACH overrides this.

cc_coach_mascot.title: Coach mascot (CC_COACH_MASCOT)
cc_coach_mascot.description: Where the coach's mascot lives: pane (pixel art, fullscreen UI), statusline (a text face) or off. The environment variable CC_COACH_MASCOT overrides this.

cc_coach_model.title: Standby judge model (CC_COACH_MODEL)
cc_coach_model.description: The model that confirms a haiku first-pass flag before a prompt is dropped: sonnet or opus. The environment variable CC_COACH_MODEL overrides this.

cc_coach_sensitivity.title: Coach sensitivity (CC_COACH_SENSITIVITY)
cc_coach_sensitivity.description: What counts as unclear: unactionable (nobody could act on it) or ambiguous (also two readings of scope). The environment variable CC_COACH_SENSITIVITY overrides this.
